Jocelyn Benson

Democratic candidate for Governor / Lt. Governor, Michigan · Open seat

Michigan Secretary of State

Jocelyn Benson is a Democrat who has been Michigan's Secretary of State since 2019. She is the Democratic nominee for governor in the November 3, 2026 general election. Her running mate for lieutenant governor is state Senate Majority Leader Winnie Brinks of Grand Rapids.

Where Benson stands

Health care costs
Proposes creating a prescription drug affordability board and streamlining the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services. She says outdated infrastructure slows the department down.
Health care
Describes her health platform as centered on access, affordability and fairness, and says fixing outdated MDHHS infrastructure is the centerpiece of her plan.
Gas prices
Said at the October 6 debate that she is open to a state gas tax holiday.
